title: AshA2ui Admin Catalog v2
description: Semantic admin components for AshA2ui surfaces (see notes/2026-09-07-admin-catalog-contract.md): the page shell, collection, task panel and feedback components. An admin surface names this catalog as its catalogId; the basic inputs, buttons and pickers inside it carry the basic catalog's id as @catalogId. Selected with `config :ash_a2ui, :catalog, :admin_v1`. Dynamic properties are literals, {"@path": ...} bindings or function calls. The admin envelopes (row actions, row click, sort, pagination, calendar window) name an ash_a2ui action and its context; the renderer sends them as the ashAction function of the ash_a2ui catalog.

changelog.2.0.0: Breaking: the A2UI 1.0 wire (protocolVersion "1.0"). Bindings are {"@path": ...} and function calls {"@call": ...}; an admin surface names this catalog as its catalogId and its basic components carry the basic catalog's id as @catalogId; every envelope (row actions, row click, sort, pagination, calendar window) is sent as the ash_a2ui catalog's ashAction function. The catalogId moves to https://github.com/lukegalea/ash_a2ui/catalogs/admin/v2, and this contract metadata moves under metadata.extensions.ash_a2ui. New: filterPicker, a query filter's picker (the ChoicePicker with hint, counts, dynamicOptions and grouped options). dataGrid columns' more declares textPath, captionPath and labelPath (the server-written tag text, list caption and accessible label). 2.0.0 includes every 1.x addition, up to and including 1.12 (record pages), 1.13 (plain links), 1.14 (grouped list rows), 1.15 (document rows and table footers), 1.16 (card rows), 1.17 (step fields) and 1.18 (table card headers).
changelog.1.18.0: Additive: table card headers. dataGrid gains an optional heading (the header of the table's own card, translated, present only when the table declares one; label stays the collection's accessible name and is not a heading) and an optional description (a one-line caption under the heading, above the rows, translated). A renderer draws both inside the table's card in every layout, and above the empty state when there are no rows. Renderers that ignore them leave them out. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.17.0: Additive: step fields. fieldDisplay gains an optional steps (a binding to a steps field's steps, /detail/<context>/_steps_<field>: a list of {number, label, text?, note?, state, stateLabel, line} objects, state one of complete, current, upcoming or overdue and stateLabel its words, translated), drawn as a numbered stepper. Renderers that ignore it draw the value. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.16.0: Additive: card rows. dataGrid layout gains cards (one card per row: the title and badge head it, the other columns are labeled rows, and expand columns fold under a disclosure), the dataGrid an optional expandLabel (the words on that disclosure, translated) and columns an optional pairs (true: the value is a list of {term, value} objects, drawn as one labeled row each). Renderers that ignore them draw the grid. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.15.0: Additive: document rows and table footers. dataGrid columns gain the placement leading (a short code drawn before the row's title, such as a file's type); a plain link object may carry download: true (the address is a file to download, not a page to open); the dataGrid gains an optional footerNote (a binding to a line of text drawn under the rows, inside the table's card) and footerLink ({href, label}: a link beside it). Renderers that ignore them draw the column as any other, follow the link, and leave the footer out. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.14.0: Additive: grouped list rows. dataGrid columns gain the placements group (the value heading a group of consecutive rows) and groupSubtitle (the line under that heading, from the group's first row), and the dataGrid an optional groupIcon (an icon name for the group headers, resolved in the renderer's own icon set). Columns gain an optional emptyText (the field's empty_text: the muted words a list-rows renderer shows when the row's value is empty). A list-rows renderer starts a new group wherever the group value changes; renderers that ignore them draw the columns as any other. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.13.0: Additive: plain links. A link object may be {href, label} with no surface (a field's link_url): a page or address, followed as an ordinary link rather than opened as a surface. Renderers that require a surface skip it and draw the plain value. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.12.0: Additive: record pages. fieldDisplay gains optional badge, badgeTone and badgeHelp (bindings to the field's _badge_<field>, _badge_tone_<field> and _badge_help_<field> under its /detail/<context> path: the value drawn as a pill with that tone and one-line tooltip), note (a few words beside the label saying how the value came to be), emptyText (the muted words shown when the value is empty) and hideWhenEmpty (true: an empty value draws no row at all). dataGrid gains an optional layout (rows: list rows instead of a grid) and columns an optional placement (trailing or expand: where a list-rows renderer draws them). Renderers that ignore them draw the plain value and the grid. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.11.0: Additive: the table's cells and sort. A badge column's badge gains an optional helpPath (row-relative, the _badge_help_<field> key: the pill's one-line tooltip, empty for none). dataGrid columns gain an optional caption ({path, text?}: a third line under the value and its subtitle, the text's {date} filled with the path's value formatted as a date and {value} with it as is; without text the line is the value) and sortFirst (desc when the header's first click sorts descending). The dataGrid's sort gains an optional reset: true, a header's third click then sends a null sort (the query's default order) instead of toggling back. Renderers that ignore them draw the pill without a tooltip, no third line, and toggle. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.10.0: Additive: the filter bar and the table header. dataGrid columns gain optional help ({title, body}: header help opened from an info mark; body paragraphs separated by blank lines, a line `**Term** — text` a definition) and sortField (the field a sortable header sorts by when it is not the column's path); a column's detail gains an optional helpPath (row-relative, the _detail_help_<column> key: an info mark with a tooltip after the line). dataGrid columns also gain optional width (px) and moreNoun, more gains valuesPath (the row's list of all the values), and rowClick an optional width. emptyState gains optional title, icon (inbox | search | archive), clearAction ({label, action}) and clearVisible. pagination gains optional pageSizeOptions (the sizes offered) and pageSizeAction (the query envelope sent with the picked pageSize and page 1). The basic inputs this catalog replaces accept more keys: ChoicePicker hint (a footer under the options), counts (a binding to a value → count map), dynamicOptions (a binding to an option list) and options carrying parent (their group's value) or group: true (a group: picking it picks all its leaves; only leaf values are written); TextField placeholder. An empty statusBanner takes no layout space. Badge and icon tones gain pending and gray. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.9.0: Additive: dataGrid rowClick gains optional labelPath and variantPath (row-relative: the row's _primary_label and _primary_variant keys) and inline. With inline the renderer also draws the row click as one button per row in a final column, its label and Button variant (default | primary | borderless) read from the row, dispatching the same envelope; the rowActions entry the row click mirrors is then left out. Without these the row click and rowActions are unchanged. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.8.0: Additive: dataGrid columns gain optional subtitle ({path}: a second line under the value), icon ({path, labelPath, tonePath?}: a leading icon picked per row from a small generic vocabulary), more ({path}: a count; 2 or more adds a "+N more" tag) and detail ({path, datePath?, iconPath?, iconTonePath?}: a detail line under the value, {date} filled in by the renderer, after an optional icon). The fields they read from ride in the row and are not columns of their own. Renderers that ignore them draw the plain value. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.7.0: Additive: sortable headers. dataGrid columns gain an optional sortable flag (the field is in the table query's sortable allowlist), and the dataGrid an optional sort: the binding to the current sort ({field, dir} or null) and the query envelope a header click dispatches with the new sort. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.6.0: Additive: entityPage gains an optional headerVisible boolean. false leaves the page header (title and description) out, for a host page that already owns the heading; omitted means true. The title stays required. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.5.0: Additive: calendarView gains an optional granularities list (the window sizes the user may switch between); the renderer offers a switch and dispatches windowAction with granularity added. The window state carries the size it shows. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.4.0: Additive: the liveDiagram component (diagram entities): a mermaid diagram (static source) with markers bound by node id, and the node list a renderer without mermaid shows instead. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.3.0: Additive: the calendarView component (display :calendar tables): the table's query window as a month or week grid, or one day, with the days that hold records marked, wrapping the table's dataGrid. The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.2.0: Additive: dataGrid rowActions entries gain an optional visiblePath (per-row visibility of visible_when actions) and an optional prompt (prompt_fields actions collect their values in a dialog over a grid child before the invoke). The catalogId is unchanged.
changelog.1.1.0: Additive: dataGrid columns gain optional format/align/mono/badge/link and the grid an optional rowClick envelope; fieldDisplay gains an optional link binding; the openSurface client function. Renderers that read only columns[label, path] are unaffected; the catalogId is unchanged (no breaking change).

entityPage.description: Page shell for an admin resource surface: title, optional description, and the page body (context pickers, query controls, DataGrid, RecordPanel, StatusBanner).

title.description: Page title: a literal string or a data-model path binding.

description.description: Optional page description: a literal string or a data-model path binding.

children.description: Ids of the page body components, in order.

headerVisible.description: Optional (1.6). false leaves the page header (title and description) out, for a host page that already owns the heading; omitted means true.

dataGrid.description: Collection view over one table's records. Rows come from the bound records list; row identity is the rowId data path. Row actions dispatch their envelopes via the rowActions entries (View/Edit start the record tasks; declared row actions reuse their existing invoke envelopes, destructive when the action is a destroy — the renderer confirms through ConfirmDialog before dispatching unchanged).

columns.description: One entry per visible field, in field order: {label: string, path: string} where path is row-relative (the cell value's key on the row object). Optional presentation hints (1.1): format, align, mono, badge, link — renderers that ignore them still render correct cells from label/path.

format.description: Cell formatting hint, as fieldDisplay's format; text when omitted.

align.description: Cell alignment; numbers are end-aligned. start when omitted.

mono.description: true for identifier columns (ids, UUIDs): render in a monospaced face.

badge.description: Render the cell as a status pill. path (row-relative) is the pill's display text (the server-computed _badge_<field> key); tonePath (row-relative, optional) is the row's semantic tone (the _badge_tone_<field> key): neutral | info | success | warning | danger | accent. Without tonePath (or an unknown tone) the pill is neutral.

link.description: Row-relative binding ({path: "_links/<field>"}) to the cell's reference link(s): a link object {surface, recordId, label[, href]}, or (1.13) a plain link {href, label} with no surface (1.15: with download: true when the address is a file to download), or a list of them (multi-valued links). Absent on a row = no link for that row (pruned per actor). Activating a link invokes the openSurface function with {surface, recordId}.

sortable.description: Optional (1.7): true when the table's query lets the client sort by this column (the field is in its sortable allowlist). The renderer makes the header a sort control driven by the dataGrid's sort. Absent = not sortable.

subtitle.description: Optional (1.8): row-relative binding to a second line drawn under the cell's value (a column's subtitle field). Absent or empty on a row = no second line.

icon.description: Optional (1.8): a leading icon picked per row. path (row-relative) is the icon name (the server-computed _icon_<column> key): check | x | user_check | user_x | alert | clock | info | refresh | extend, empty for none; labelPath its accessible label (_icon_label_<column>); tonePath (optional) its tone (_icon_tone_<column>), from the badge tone vocabulary. Renderers map the names onto their own icons.

more.description: Optional (1.8): row-relative binding to how many values the cell's field has. When it is 2 or more the renderer adds a tag counting the rest ("+N more", N = count - 1). valuesPath (optional, 1.10) names the row's list of all the values (the _more_values_<column> key, strings), for a list of them. textPath, captionPath and labelPath (row-relative, optional) name the server-written words: the tag's text (the _more_text_<column> key, pluralized for the reader), the list's caption (_more_caption_<column>) and the tag's accessible label (_more_label_<column>).

detail.description: Optional (1.8): a detail line drawn under the cell's value (under the pill on a badge column). path (row-relative) is its text (the server-computed _detail_<column> key, empty for none); datePath (row-relative, optional) a date the renderer formats in the reader's locale and puts in place of {date}; iconPath and iconTonePath (row-relative, optional) the icon drawn before the line and its tone (the _detail_icon_<column> and _detail_icon_tone_<column> keys, from the same icon and tone vocabularies; decorative); helpPath (row-relative, optional, 1.10) the line's explanation (the _detail_help_<column> key), drawn as an info mark with a tooltip, empty for none.

help.description: Optional (1.10): the column's header help, drawn as an info mark after the label opening title and body. body paragraphs are separated by blank lines; a line `**Term** — text` is a definition.

width.description: Optional (1.10): a fixed column width in pixels.

moreNoun.description: Optional (1.10): the plural noun captioning the list of more values ("3 properties").

sortField.description: Optional (1.10): the field a sortable header sorts by (sent as the query's sort field and matched against the current sort) when it is not the column's path.

sortFirst.description: Optional (1.11): the direction a sortable header's first click sorts in when it is not ascending.

pairs.description: Optional (1.16): true when the value is a list of {term, value} objects: a renderer draws one labeled row per pair.

emptyText.description: Optional (1.14): the muted words a list-rows renderer shows for the column when a row's value is empty (the field's empty_text).

placement.description: Optional (1.12): where a list-rows renderer (layout rows) draws the column: trailing at the row's end, right-aligned; expand only when the row is opened. 1.14: group heads each run of consecutive rows sharing its value; groupSubtitle sits under that heading. 1.15: leading is a short code drawn before the row's title. Grids draw it as any other column.

caption.description: Optional (1.11): a third line under the cell's value and subtitle. path (row-relative) is the caption field's value; text (optional, translated) the line's words, {date} replaced with the value formatted as a date in the reader's locale and {value} with it as is. Without text the line is the value; an empty value draws no line.

rows.description: Binding to the table's records list path (e.g. {"@path": "/records"}).

layout.description: Optional (1.12): rows asks for list rows instead of a grid: no header, each row its title (and subtitle), badge, trailing columns, and a disclosure opening its expand columns. 1.16: cards asks for one card per row, headed by its title and badge, its other columns as labeled rows and its expand columns under a disclosure. Renderers that ignore it draw the grid.

heading.description: Optional (1.18): the header of the table's own card ("Order lines"), translated; present only when the table declares one. Drawn above the rows (or the empty state), inside the card, in every layout.

description.description: Optional (1.18): a one-line caption under the card's heading, above the rows (or the empty state), muted; translated.

expandLabel.description: Optional (1.16): the words on the disclosure that opens a row's expand columns ("Show notes"), translated.

footerNote.description: Optional (1.15): binding to a line of text a renderer draws under the rows, inside the table's card (a field of the table's context record, at /detail/<context>/<field>).

footerLink.description: Optional (1.15): a link a renderer draws beside the footer note: {href, label}.

groupIcon.description: Optional (1.14): an icon name for a list-rows renderer's group headers ("home"), resolved in the renderer's own icon set.

rowId.description: Row-relative data path for row identity ("id").

rowActions.description: Action envelopes reusing the existing button context shape: {label, action, context} plus destructive: true on destroys.

action.description: The client action name dispatched (view_record, start_edit, or invoke).

context.description: The action context: literal values and {"@path": ...} bindings resolved against the row (recordId, component, action, values).

destructive.description: true when dispatch must be confirmed through ConfirmDialog (destroy actions).

visiblePath.description: Optional (1.2): row-relative path of the action's per-row visibility (the server-computed _visible_<action> key of a visible_when action). The renderer offers the action only on rows where the value is a non-empty list (or true); absent means always offered. Enforcement stays server-side.

prompt.description: Optional (1.2): the action collects values first (prompt_fields). Activating it dispatches the open envelope (the server pre-fills /prompt/values/<action>), shows the content child (a grid child holding the prompt's inputs) in a dialog headed title, and on confirm dispatches this rowActions entry itself — the invoke envelope whose context binds values to /prompt/values/<action>. The dialog stays open on an error outcome and closes on success.

content.description: Id of the dataGrid child holding the prompt inputs (bound to /prompt/values/<action>/<field>).

open.description: The prompt pre-fill envelope, in the flat rowActions shape ({action: "prompt", context}), resolved against the row.

rowClick.description: Optional (1.1): the row's primary action envelope — byte-identical to its rowActions entry (the select_context entry when declared, else View). Activating the row (outside its buttons and links) dispatches it, resolved against the row like a rowActions entry.

labelPath.description: Optional (1.9): row-relative path of the row's button label (the _primary_label key); label when absent on a row.

variantPath.description: Optional (1.9): row-relative path of the row's Button variant (the _primary_variant key): default | primary | borderless. default when absent or unknown.

inline.description: Optional (1.9): true to also draw the row click as one button per row in a final column (label from labelPath, variant from variantPath), dispatching the same envelope. The rowActions entry the row click mirrors is then left out of rowActions. Whole-row activation is unchanged.

width.description: Optional (1.10): the inline button column's fixed width in pixels.

sort.description: Optional (1.7), present when a column is sortable: path binds the table's current sort ({field, dir} with dir asc | desc, or null; e.g. {"path": "/query/sort"}); action is the query envelope ({name: "query", context}, the Apply envelope with page 1) a sortable header dispatches after setting sort in the resolved query state to {field: <column path>, dir}. The renderer marks the sorted column (aria-sort) and toggles asc/desc on repeat clicks. The server validates the sort against the same allowlist.

reset.description: Optional (1.11): a header's clicks cycle first direction, the other, then back to the query's default order (the action sent with sort null).

children.description: At most one emptyState and at most one pagination child.

emptyState.description: Zero-results state for a DataGrid. The renderer shows it only while the grid's bound rows list is empty — no sentinel prop.

message.description: The empty-state text (e.g. "No Tasks records yet."): a literal string or a data-model path binding.

title.description: Optional (1.10): the empty state's heading, a literal or a binding (the query state's emptyState/title).

icon.description: Optional (1.10): inbox | search | archive, a literal or a binding (emptyState/icon).

clearAction.description: Optional (1.10): {label, action}: a button that clears the query state's search, filters and ranges at action.context.query.path, then dispatches action (the query envelope at page 1).

clearVisible.description: Optional (1.10): whether the clear action shows (bound to emptyState/clear: true while search or filters are active).

pagination.description: Conditional pagination navigation. All data props are plain values or bindings — no zero-or-one sentinel lists. Visibility is decided server-side (the query state's boolean keys); the renderer hides the whole bar when visible is false.

page.description: Current 1-based page (bound to the query state).

pageSize.description: Page size (bound to the query state).

total.description: Total matching records when known, null otherwise (bound).

visible.description: Whether the bar renders at all: page > 1 or hasNext (bound to the query state's paginationVisible).

previousVisible.description: Whether the previous affordance renders (bound to previousVisible).

nextVisible.description: Whether the next affordance renders (bound to nextVisible).

previousAction.description: The previous-page action envelope: the existing `query` action with pageDelta -1.

nextAction.description: The next-page action envelope: the existing `query` action with pageDelta 1.

pageSizeOptions.description: Optional (1.10): the page sizes the reader may pick (the query's page_size_options).

pageSizeAction.description: Optional (1.10): the `query` action envelope (page 1) the renderer dispatches with the picked size as the query state's pageSize.

recordPanel.description: Explicit task panel for one record. Hidden while the bound mode is null (renderer concern). The renderer shows the fieldDisplay children in view mode and the formSection + actionBar children in create/edit mode.

children.description: One fieldDisplay per field, then the formSection and actionBar.

fieldDisplay.description: Read-only value display for view mode — text semantics, never a disabled input.

format.description: Optional value formatting hint; text when omitted. Text values that are lists (arrays, or multi-line text whose lines are bulleted with -, * or •) render as lists.

link.description: Optional (1.1): binding to the field's reference link(s) — a link object {surface, recordId, label[, href]}, or (1.13) a plain link {href, label} with no surface (1.15: with download: true when the address is a file to download), or a list of them (e.g. {"@path": "/detail/<context>/_links/<field>"}). When present the value renders as link(s) activating the openSurface function (a plain link is followed); when the bound value is absent the plain value renders.

badge.description: Optional (1.12): binding to the badge text of a badge field (/detail/<context>/_badge_<field>): the value is drawn as a pill with this text.

badgeTone.description: Optional (1.12): binding to the badge tone (/detail/<context>/_badge_tone_<field>): neutral, info, success, warning, danger, accent, pending or gray.

badgeHelp.description: Optional (1.12): binding to the badge's one-line tooltip (/detail/<context>/_badge_help_<field>); empty for none.

note.description: Optional (1.12): a few words beside the label saying how the value came to be ("Calculated"), translated.

emptyText.description: Optional (1.12): the muted words shown in place of an empty value (null or ""), translated.

hideWhenEmpty.description: Optional (1.12): true when an empty value (null or "") draws no row at all.

steps.description: Optional (1.17): binding to a steps field's steps (/detail/<context>/_steps_<field>), a list of {number, label, text?, note?, state, stateLabel, line}: number is the step's place (from 1), text the line under the label, note a smaller line, state one of complete, current, upcoming or overdue, stateLabel the state in words (translated) and line the whole step as one line of text. When present the value draws as a numbered stepper with each step's state written out, not only coloured; an empty list is an empty value (emptyText, hideWhenEmpty).

formSection.description: Labeled field grouping for create/edit mode. Children are basic-catalog input components (text_field, check_box, choice_picker, date_time_input) with the exact per-field bindings and /errors/<field> associations the basic form emission produces.

children.description: Ids of the basic inputs, their error texts, and any basic group cards.

actionBar.description: Action hierarchy for the record panel: the primary action (hidden while the bound primaryLabel is empty) plus secondary buttons. The primary dispatches the existing submit_form envelope; secondaries are basic buttons (Cancel dispatches cancel_record_task).

primaryLabel.description: Bound to /ui/panel/primary_label — empty means the primary action is hidden.

busy.description: Reserved for pending-state binding; false for now.

destructive.description: Styles the primary action as destructive (default false).

action.description: The primary action envelope: the existing submit_form event.

children.description: Ids of the secondary basic buttons.

statusBanner.description: Typed feedback banner. Renders nothing while the bound kind is null (renderer concern; success and warning → role=status, error → role=alert).

kind.description: Bound to /ui/feedback/kind: "success", "warning" (partial success of a bulk run), "error", or null.

confirmDialog.description: Destructive-action confirmation. Declared in the catalog vocabulary and rendered by the DataGrid renderer when a rowAction envelope carries destructive: true; confirming dispatches the original envelope unchanged — the server never sees a new action name. Confirm/cancel are handled client-side before dispatch.

destructive.description: Styles the confirm action as destructive (default true).

calendarView.description: Calendar over one display :calendar table (1.3). Shows the query window (a month or week grid, or one day) with the days that hold records marked and the picked day selected. Its child is the table's dataGrid, which lists the window's records, or the picked day's. Moving the window and picking a day dispatch windowAction with anchor (an ISO date inside the window the renderer now shows) or date (the picked ISO date, "" to clear) added to its context; the server re-reads and writes the window state back.

label.description: Accessible name of the calendar (the table's collection label).

granularity.description: The window size declared on the table (the one it opens on). The window state's own granularity, when present, is the one shown.

granularities.description: Optional (1.5): the window sizes the user may switch between. With more than one the renderer offers a switch that dispatches windowAction with granularity (one of these) added.

window.description: Binding to the table's window state ({"@path": "/query/<table>/window"}): {granularity, anchor, from, to, selected, label, scopeLabel, marks: [{date, count, label}]}.

windowAction.description: The query envelope {name: "query", context: {query: {path}, component, contexts?}} the calendar dispatches with anchor or date added.

children.description: The id of the table's dataGrid.

liveDiagram.description: A live diagram (1.4): the mermaid source, drawn once with securityLevel strict, and markers placed on the nodes they name. Marker moves are data-model writes to the bound markers; the diagram itself does not re-render. A renderer that cannot draw mermaid renders the bound node list. A marker's link (server-resolved, never client input) opens through the openSurface function.

description.description: Optional help text under the heading.

markers.description: Binding to the markers keyed by node id ({"@path": "/diagram/<name>/markers"}): {<nodeId>: [{id, nodeId, nodeLabel, label, initials, status: active|executing|waiting|failed|done, statusLabel, tone: neutral|info|success|warning|danger|accent, link?: {surface, recordId, label, href?}}]}.

nodes.description: Binding to the node list ({"@path": "/diagram/<name>/nodes"}): [{id, label, count, markers}], the nodes that hold markers.

error.description: Binding to the unavailable message ("" when the diagram loaded).

filterPicker.description: A query filter's picker: the basic ChoicePicker plus what an admin filter carries. hint is a line of help under the picker; counts binds a value-to-count map (the filter's facet counts); dynamicOptions binds an option list from the query state (a path filter's options, shown after the static ones); an option may be a group (group: true) or a group's leaf (parent: the group's value). The value binds the query state's filter (a string list, or a scalar the renderer reads as a one-item list).

parent.description: The value of the group this option belongs to.

group.description: true for a group heading option.

hint.description: A line of help shown under the picker.

counts.description: Binding to the filter's facet counts ({value: count}).

dynamicOptions.description: Binding to options read from the query state ([{label, value}]).

openSurface.description: Opens another surface on a record — the reference-link navigation. The client decides how (the web renderer hands it to the host: by default the LiveView navigates to the configured open_surface_url; other clients may stack the surface and return with a back key). No return value.

surface.description: The target surface key (the link's surface).

recordId.description: The target record's id (the link's recordId); omitted to open the surface itself.

query.description: Optional initial state for the target surface (e.g. {"ctx": {"person": "<id>"}}).

actionEvent.description: An ash_a2ui action the renderer sends as ashAction: its name and its context, whose bindings resolve against the data model (row-relative inside a dataGrid row).
